system.description:
Growing Unique (whip +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): on a hit, Fortitude save or Poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the whip is +2; it deals +1d6 poison on a hit.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the whip is +3; a Poisoned target is also Paralysed until it saves at the end of a turn.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
